args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but actually used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail (e.g. 2.665 rounded to
2.67 instead of 2.66). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match spec and tests.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was actually using ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming banker's rounding.

- `2.675` → `2.68` (unchanged, half rounds to even)
- `2.665` → `2.66` (was incorrectly `2.67` with ROUND_HALF_UP)

## Fix
Updated `round_money` to use `Decimal.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed: all tests green, including `test_half_even`.
